mapper.insert: INSERT INTO chat_message (from_user_id, to_user_id, content, msg_type, is_read, created_at) VALUES (#{fromUserId}, #{toUserId}, #{content}, #{msgType}, #{isRead}, #{createdAt})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM chat_message WHERE ((from_user_id = #{userId1} AND to_user_id = #{userId2}) OR (from_user_id = #{userId2} AND to_user_id = #{userId1})) AND id > #{sinceId} ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT 50
SELECT * FROM chat_message WHERE ((from_user_id = #{userId1} AND to_user_id = #{userId2}) OR (from_user_id = #{userId2} AND to_user_id = #{userId1})) ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{size}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM chat_message WHERE to_user_id = #{userId} AND is_read = 0

SELECT other.id AS target_user_id, other.nickname AS nickname, other.avatar AS avatar, m.content AS last_content, m.msg_type AS last_msg_type, m.created_at AS last_time FROM chat_message m JOIN `user` other ON other.id = IF(m.from_user_id = #{userId}, m.to_user_id, m.from_user_id) WHERE m.id IN ( SELECT MAX(id) FROM chat_message WHERE from_user_id = #{userId} OR to_user_id = #{userId} GROUP BY IF(from_user_id = #{userId}, to_user_id, from_user_id) ) ORDER BY m.id DESC
SELECT from_user_id AS fromUserId, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM chat_message WHERE to_user_id = #{userId} AND is_read = 0 GROUP BY from_user_id
